verdict.rationale: Microsoft ships the official Azure CLI, a cross-platform tool for managing Azure resources through interactive commands or scripts. It installs on Windows, Linux, macOS, Docker and Cloud Shell, and offers tab-completion and JMESPath `--query` output shaping, which suits scripted and agent-driven use. A community user confirms that almost everything can be done from the command line. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI affordances such as non-interactive agent auth flows or agent-specific usage guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Azure CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources with interactive commands or scripts.
The Azure CLI is available to install in Windows, Linux, and macOS environments. It can also be run in a Docker container and Azure Cloud Shell.
You can use the `--query` parameter and the [JMESPath](http://jmespath.org/) query syntax to customize your output.
Almost everything can be done via command line.
